prompt:
A tall man in a light blue button-down shirt with sleeves rolled to the
forearm, navy trousers and a brown leather belt, seen from behind, walking away
from camera down a vaulted municipal corridor, vertical framing. Whitewashed
stone arches overhead, spherical glass pendant lamps hanging in a row down the
centre. Pale doors along the left wall, each with a small enamel plate reading
Platz 8, Platz 9. A hanging sign in a mint-green frame reads Pass- und
Dokumentenausgabe. Black linked chairs against the right wall, empty now.
Polished grey stone floor. A dark green double door at the far end with
daylight around it. He holds a single sheet of paper down at his side.
Documentary realism, cool daylight.

Use the reference images for the man only - his height, his build, his hair
and the way he carries himself - and NOT for his clothes, which are as
described above, and NOT for the setting.
